## Modules

- [ASM.Cost](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Cost.md): Cost helpers for token usage projection and accumulation.

- [ASM.Cost.Models](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Cost.Models.md): Lightweight model pricing lookup table for provider cost estimation.

- [ASM.Execution.Config](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Execution.Config.md): Normalized execution-mode, execution-surface, and execution-environment
configuration with precedence-aware merging.
- [ASM.Execution.Environment](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Execution.Environment.md): Normalized runtime environment and policy context for ASM execution.

- [ASM.Extensions](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.md): Boundary root for optional extension domains.

- [ASM.Migration.MainCompat](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Migration.MainCompat.md): Compatibility helpers for migrating `main` SessionManager input/event shapes
to the rebuild `ASM` runtime.
- [ASM.Remote.BackendStarter](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Remote.BackendStarter.md): Remote RPC entrypoint for starting backend sessions.

- [ASM.Remote.Capabilities](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Remote.Capabilities.md): Remote node capability and compatibility handshake helpers.

- [ASM.Remote.NodeConnector](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Remote.NodeConnector.md): Remote node connection and preflight checks.

- [ASM.Schema.Event](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Schema.Event.md): Schema-backed parser for ASM runtime event envelopes before projection into
`%ASM.Event{}`.

- [ASM.Schema.ProviderOptions](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Schema.ProviderOptions.md): ASM-owned schema validation for provider option maps and provider profile
limits.

- [ASM.Schema.RemoteNode](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Schema.RemoteNode.md): Schema-backed parser for remote node execution configuration owned by ASM.

- [ASM.Telemetry](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Telemetry.md): Telemetry helpers for standard ASM runtime lifecycle signals.

- [ASM.Test](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Test.md): Test helpers for quickly creating sessions and provider fixtures.

- [ASM.Test.Factory](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Test.Factory.md): Builders for normalized runtime structs used in tests.

- Public API
  - [ASM](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.md): Public facade for the ASM session runtime.

  - [ASM.Error](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Error.md): Canonical runtime error type for ASM.

  - [ASM.Event](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Event.md): Run-scoped envelope around normalized core runtime events.
  - [ASM.History](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.History.md): Replay and rebuild helpers on top of `ASM.Store`.

  - [ASM.InferenceEndpoint](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.InferenceEndpoint.md): Publishes CLI-backed ASM providers as endpoint-shaped inference targets.

  - [ASM.Permission](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Permission.md): Normalizes permission modes into a common runtime model.
  - [ASM.ProviderRegistry](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.ProviderRegistry.md): Resolves providers to backend lanes and runtime metadata.
  - [ASM.Result](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Result.md): Final run projection returned by `ASM.query/3`.
  - [ASM.Stream](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Stream.md): Stream helpers for run event consumption and final result projection.

- Inference Endpoint Contracts
  - [ASM.InferenceEndpoint.BackendManifest](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.InferenceEndpoint.BackendManifest.md): Shared backend manifest contract for the ASM CLI inference endpoint facade.

  - [ASM.InferenceEndpoint.CompatibilityResult](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.InferenceEndpoint.CompatibilityResult.md): Shared compatibility result contract for ASM endpoint publication.

  - [ASM.InferenceEndpoint.ConsumerManifest](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.InferenceEndpoint.ConsumerManifest.md): Shared consumer manifest contract for the ASM inference endpoint facade.

  - [ASM.InferenceEndpoint.EndpointDescriptor](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.InferenceEndpoint.EndpointDescriptor.md): Shared endpoint publication contract for CLI-backed ASM inference routes.

- Backends
  - [ASM.ProviderBackend](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.ProviderBackend.md): Runtime contract for provider backends.
  - [ASM.ProviderBackend.Core](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.ProviderBackend.Core.md): Backend that runs the shared CLI runtime from `cli_subprocess_core`.

  - [ASM.ProviderBackend.SDK](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.ProviderBackend.SDK.md): Backend that runs provider SDK runtime kits when available locally.

- Providers
  - [ASM.Options](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Options.md): Shared runtime options validation and normalization.

  - [ASM.Provider](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Provider.md): Provider definition data used by the backend registry.

  - [ASM.ProviderFeatures](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.ProviderFeatures.md): Public provider feature manifests for ASM.
  - [ASM.Options.Amp](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Options.Amp.md): Amp provider-specific option schema.

  - [ASM.Options.Claude](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Options.Claude.md): Claude provider-specific option schema.

  - [ASM.Options.Codex](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Options.Codex.md): Codex exec provider-specific option schema.

  - [ASM.Options.Gemini](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Options.Gemini.md): Gemini provider-specific option schema.

  - [ASM.Options.Shell](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Options.Shell.md): Shell provider-specific option schema.

  - [ASM.Provider.ExampleSupport](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Provider.ExampleSupport.md): Provider-specific values used by examples and setup guidance.

  - [ASM.Provider.Profile](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Provider.Profile.md): Session admission defaults for a provider.

  - [ASM.ProviderBackend.Event](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.ProviderBackend.Event.md): ASM-owned event delivery envelope emitted by provider backends.

  - [ASM.ProviderBackend.Info](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.ProviderBackend.Info.md): ASM-owned backend metadata contract consumed by the orchestration kernel.

- Runtime
  - [ASM.SessionControl](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.SessionControl.md): Provider-native session control helpers for historical resume and
interrupt-then-intervene flows.

  - [ASM.SessionControl.Entry](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.SessionControl.Entry.md): Standardized provider-native resumable session entry.

  - [ASM.Run.ApprovalCoordinator](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Run.ApprovalCoordinator.md): Pure state helper for approval ownership indexing.

  - [ASM.Run.EventReducer](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Run.EventReducer.md): Deterministic reducer from run-scoped events to result projections.

  - [ASM.Run.Server](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Run.Server.md): Per-run worker that owns backend lifecycle and event fanout.

  - [ASM.Run.State](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Run.State.md): Run process state with reducer-owned projection fields.

  - [ASM.Run.Supervisor](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Run.Supervisor.md): Dynamic supervisor for per-run workers.

  - [ASM.Session.Continuation](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Session.Continuation.md): Session checkpoint helpers for capture and restore seams.

  - [ASM.Session.Server](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Session.Server.md): Session aggregate root for run admission, approval routing, and cost totals.

  - [ASM.Session.State](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Session.State.md): Aggregate state owned by `ASM.Session.Server`.

  - [ASM.Session.Subtree](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Session.Subtree.md): Per-session supervision subtree.
  - [ASM.Session.Supervisor](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Session.Supervisor.md): Root dynamic supervisor for session subtrees.

- Streaming &amp; Tooling
  - [ASM.Store](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Store.md): Persistence contract for event storage and replay.

  - [ASM.Tool](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Tool.md): Behaviour for run-time tool handlers.

  - [ASM.Store.Memory](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Store.Memory.md): In-memory event store with idempotent append by event id.

  - [ASM.Tool.Executor](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Tool.Executor.md): Synchronous tool execution adapter used by `ASM.Run.Server`.

  - [ASM.Tool.MCP](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Tool.MCP.md): Optional MCP tool bridge placeholder.

- Pipeline
  - [ASM.Pipeline](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Pipeline.md): Synchronous event pipeline with optional event injection.

  - [ASM.Pipeline.CostTracker](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Pipeline.CostTracker.md): Pipeline plug that emits `:cost_update` control events from result usage.

  - [ASM.Pipeline.Plug](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Pipeline.Plug.md): Behaviour for synchronous run-event pipeline plugs.

  - [ASM.Pipeline.PolicyGuard](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Pipeline.PolicyGuard.md): Pipeline plug that enforces lightweight policy checks on events.

- Payload Types
  - [ASM.Content](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Content.md): Content block variants shared across messages.

  - [ASM.Control](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Control.md): Control-layer payload variants.

  - [ASM.Message](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Message.md): Conversation-layer payload variants.

  - [ASM.Content.Text](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Content.Text.md): Plain text content emitted by a model response.

  - [ASM.Content.Thinking](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Content.Thinking.md): Provider thinking content, optionally signed when supported.

  - [ASM.Content.ToolResult](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Content.ToolResult.md): Tool response payload linked to a prior tool call.

  - [ASM.Content.ToolUse](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Content.ToolUse.md): Structured request to invoke a named tool with JSON input.

  - [ASM.Control.ApprovalRequest](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Control.ApprovalRequest.md): Tool approval prompt emitted when the provider requires operator input.

  - [ASM.Control.ApprovalResolution](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Control.ApprovalResolution.md): Approval decision sent back to resume or block a tool call.

  - [ASM.Control.CostUpdate](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Control.CostUpdate.md): Incremental token and cost accounting update.

  - [ASM.Control.GuardrailTrigger](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Control.GuardrailTrigger.md): Signal that a policy/guardrail rule was triggered.

  - [ASM.Control.Raw](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Control.Raw.md): Provider-native control event preserved in normalized form.

  - [ASM.Control.RunLifecycle](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Control.RunLifecycle.md): Run lifecycle checkpoint emitted by the runtime.

  - [ASM.Message.Assistant](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Message.Assistant.md): Assistant-authored message composed of one or more content blocks.

  - [ASM.Message.Error](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Message.Error.md): Structured error message emitted by the provider/runtime.

  - [ASM.Message.Partial](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Message.Partial.md): Incremental text or thinking delta emitted during streaming.

  - [ASM.Message.Raw](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Message.Raw.md): Provider-native message event preserved in normalized form.

  - [ASM.Message.Result](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Message.Result.md): Terminal metadata describing why a run completed.

  - [ASM.Message.System](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Message.System.md): System-level initialization payloads.

  - [ASM.Message.Thinking](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Message.Thinking.md): Provider thinking payload emitted as a top-level message.

  - [ASM.Message.ToolResult](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Message.ToolResult.md): Result returned to the model for a previously requested tool call.

  - [ASM.Message.ToolUse](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Message.ToolUse.md): Request from the model to execute a tool.

  - [ASM.Message.User](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Message.User.md): User-authored message composed of one or more content blocks.

- Extensions/Persistence
  - [ASM.Extensions.Persistence](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.Persistence.md): Public persistence extension API.
  - [ASM.Extensions.Persistence.Adapter](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.Persistence.Adapter.md): Store adapter contract for persistence extension implementations.

  - [ASM.Extensions.Persistence.FileStore](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.Persistence.FileStore.md): Durable append-only event store backed by a local file.
  - [ASM.Extensions.Persistence.PipelinePlug](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.Persistence.PipelinePlug.md): Non-blocking pipeline plug that forwards events to an async persistence writer.
  - [ASM.Extensions.Persistence.Writer](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.Persistence.Writer.md): Async writer process that persists events outside the run process path.

- Extensions/Routing
  - [ASM.Extensions.Routing](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.Routing.md): Public routing extension API.
  - [ASM.Extensions.Routing.HealthTracker](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.Routing.HealthTracker.md): Provider health state machine with temporary exclusion windows.

  - [ASM.Extensions.Routing.Router](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.Routing.Router.md): Extension-owned routing process for provider selection and failover.

  - [ASM.Extensions.Routing.Strategy](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.Routing.Strategy.md): Selection strategy contract for routing provider candidates.

  - [ASM.Extensions.Routing.Strategy.Priority](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.Routing.Strategy.Priority.md): Stable priority strategy that always picks the lowest priority value.

  - [ASM.Extensions.Routing.Strategy.RoundRobin](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.Routing.Strategy.RoundRobin.md): Deterministic round-robin strategy.

  - [ASM.Extensions.Routing.Strategy.Weighted](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.Routing.Strategy.Weighted.md): Deterministic weighted round-robin strategy.

- Extensions/Policy
  - [ASM.Extensions.Policy](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.Policy.md): Public policy extension API.
  - [ASM.Extensions.Policy.Enforcer](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.Policy.Enforcer.md): Sync-only policy pipeline plug.
  - [ASM.Extensions.Policy.Violation](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.Policy.Violation.md): Normalized policy-violation descriptor with explicit action semantics.

- Extensions/Rendering
  - [ASM.Extensions.Rendering](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.Rendering.md): Public rendering extension API.
  - [ASM.Extensions.Rendering.Renderer](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.Rendering.Renderer.md): Behaviour for rendering `%ASM.Event{}` values into display iodata.

  - [ASM.Extensions.Rendering.Renderers.Compact](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.Rendering.Renderers.Compact.md): Compact token renderer for `%ASM.Event{}` streams.

  - [ASM.Extensions.Rendering.Renderers.Verbose](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.Rendering.Renderers.Verbose.md): Verbose line-by-line renderer for `%ASM.Event{}` streams.

  - [ASM.Extensions.Rendering.Sink](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.Rendering.Sink.md): Behaviour for sink destinations that receive rendered iodata and events.

  - [ASM.Extensions.Rendering.Sinks.Callback](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.Rendering.Sinks.Callback.md): Sink that forwards events and rendered iodata to a callback function.
  - [ASM.Extensions.Rendering.Sinks.File](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.Rendering.Sinks.File.md): Sink that writes rendered output to a file with ANSI escape codes stripped.
  - [ASM.Extensions.Rendering.Sinks.JSONL](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.Rendering.Sinks.JSONL.md): Sink that writes events as newline-delimited JSON.
  - [ASM.Extensions.Rendering.Sinks.TTY](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.Rendering.Sinks.TTY.md): Sink that writes rendered output to an IO device (default: `:stdio`).

- Extensions/Workspace
  - [ASM.Extensions.Workspace](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.Workspace.md): Public workspace extension API.
  - [ASM.Extensions.Workspace.Backend](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.Workspace.Backend.md): Behavior contract for workspace snapshot backends.

  - [ASM.Extensions.Workspace.Diff](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.Workspace.Diff.md): Workspace diff result between two snapshots.

  - [ASM.Extensions.Workspace.GitBackend](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.Workspace.GitBackend.md): Git-backed workspace snapshots, diffs, and rollback.

  - [ASM.Extensions.Workspace.HashBackend](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.Workspace.HashBackend.md): Filesystem hash backend used when git snapshots are unavailable.

  - [ASM.Extensions.Workspace.Snapshot](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.Workspace.Snapshot.md): Immutable workspace snapshot descriptor.

- Extensions/PubSub
  - [ASM.Extensions.PubSub](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.PubSub.md): Public PubSub extension API.
  - [ASM.Extensions.PubSub.Adapter](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.PubSub.Adapter.md): Behaviour for PubSub adapter implementations.
  - [ASM.Extensions.PubSub.Adapters.Local](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.PubSub.Adapters.Local.md): Local in-node PubSub adapter built on `Registry` duplicate keys.
  - [ASM.Extensions.PubSub.Adapters.Phoenix](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.PubSub.Adapters.Phoenix.md): Phoenix PubSub adapter.
  - [ASM.Extensions.PubSub.Broadcaster](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.PubSub.Broadcaster.md): Async broadcaster process that publishes `%ASM.Event{}` outside run-critical paths.
  - [ASM.Extensions.PubSub.Payload](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.PubSub.Payload.md): Canonical payload contract for PubSub broadcast events.
  - [ASM.Extensions.PubSub.PipelinePlug](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.PubSub.PipelinePlug.md): Non-blocking pipeline plug that forwards events to an async PubSub broadcaster.
  - [ASM.Extensions.PubSub.Topic](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.PubSub.Topic.md): Canonical topic strategy for PubSub event fanout.

- Extensions/Provider Native
  - [ASM.Extensions.Provider](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.Provider.md): Boundary root reserved for provider add-on extension domains.
  - [ASM.Extensions.ProviderSDK](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.ProviderSDK.md): Public discovery API for optional provider-native extension namespaces.
  - [ASM.Extensions.ProviderSDK.Claude](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.ProviderSDK.Claude.md): Discovery metadata and bridge helpers for the optional Claude-native ASM
extension namespace.
  - [ASM.Extensions.ProviderSDK.Codex](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.ProviderSDK.Codex.md): Discovery metadata and bridge helpers for the optional Codex-native ASM
extension namespace.
  - [ASM.Extensions.ProviderSDK.Extension](https://agent-session-manager.hexdocs.pm/ASM.Extensions.ProviderSDK.Extension.md): Metadata contract for an optional provider-native ASM extension namespace.
